how_to_run: From this folder: python3 ../../framework-evals/run_eval.py <out-dir> <eval-id>... --evals evals.json (runs: 3 each; the improve student scripts are in framework-evals/students/; dir: fixtures are relative to this folder).

evals.name: loads-requirements-diff-keys

sessions.prompt: Run the improve skill on Expense Report Approval.
Run the improve skill on Expense Report Approval. We opened the regression round last time, and I've re-run all four test inputs; the new round is finished.

evals.expected_output: Improve loads the Workflow Requirements in Phase 1, opens the regression round with a D1 reading line, and its baseline diff carries D1 reading; two routes only.
preconditions: When the AI asked the student to confirm a summary, the student confirmed it.

expectations.text: Improve's opening is today's, word for word

check.text: A review takes 30–45 minutes: we look at what the run log shows, re-run your test inputs to see which lines changed, and end with one of three calls — leave it, tune it, or go back to the design.

expectations.text: In Phase 1 Improve loads the Workflow Requirements as well as the plan, Run Card, test results and run log: its review refers to something only `requirements.md` holds (D1's $5,000 rule, the receipt-matching rule, or a `## Path` step)
The baseline round is renamed with a date suffix
The new regression round is opened at `round_status: in-progress`
The new round's check list carries `D1 reading`
The new round records the plan as `design_plan:`
The baseline diff reports `D1 reading` on E2 as flipped from met (baseline, 2026-09-12) to not met (this round) and ties it to the handwritten-tip runs in the run log
Improve ends with one of its three calls; a fix goes to Build (tune) or Design (redesign). It offers no route that edits `requirements.md` first
The baseline file is not lost or changed
